answer.because: At precision 20, head's acos(1-1e-20) returns 1.414213562373079e-10, where the true rounded value is 1.4142135623730950488e-10; it also gets 1-1e-15 and 1-1e-10 wrong. Base returns all three correctly, against a sqrt-series reference that uses no trig, which shows the digits are lost to cancellation in the new pi/2 − asin(x) path.
